title: Product Lead
description:
About The Role
 We're looking for a Product Lead with real technical depth and an  AI-first way of working . You'll own a product area end to end: finding problems worth solving, shaping the solution, taking it from 0 to 1 and growing it from there.
You understand architecture, you've written code, you know how databases work, and you speak engineering fluently. Your main job is product. The technical depth is what lets you move faster and make better calls.
AI isn't a feature we're adding. It's how we work and how we build. Expect roughly 70% product and 30% engineering, with full accountability for results.
Your Mission
 Product direction: set the vision, strategy and roadmap for your area. Decide what to build, why, and how success is measured.
 0-to-1 delivery: take new products and features from problem discovery to launch and iteration.
 Discovery and validation: work directly with users and data to understand real problems, not assumed ones. Run interviews, usability tests and experiments before committing to build.
 Metrics and outcomes: define, instrument and track the KPIs for your area. Use product analytics to find friction, prioritise the highest-impact work, and shut down what doesn't work.
 Engineering partnership: understand architectural trade-offs, review technical approaches and unblock decisions. Write specs engineers actually want to read: clear, technical and opinionated.
 AI and automation: find where LLMs and agents create real product value, build the case, and ship it.
 Fast prototyping: validate ideas with AI tools (Claude, Cursor, Copilot, agents), scripts, no-code, or whatever gets you to the answer quickest.
 Hands-on work: write queries, dig into data pipelines, spin up prototypes, and open a PR when it makes sense.
 Prioritisation: balance user impact, business value, effort and regulatory constraints, and work closely with Engineering, Design, Analytics and business owners to ship continuously.
Your Profile
 5+ years in product management or product engineering with strong technical involvement, and a track record of taking products from 0 to live use with real users.
 AI-native: you use LLMs, vibe coding and agents daily, and you've applied LLMs or agentic AI to real products.
 Strong in Python or a similar language, enough to build things yourself. Comfortable with SQL, git, databases and evaluating system architecture.
 Fluent in product analytics and research: you define metrics, read data yourself, and validate through interviews, usability testing and experiments.
 Strong grasp of UX. You can take a complex flow and make it simple.
 Experience shipping with Design and Engineering in an agile environment.
 Clear communicator in English and self-directed. You can explain technical decisions to non-technical people, write specs engineers respect, and don't wait to be told what matters.
 Nice to Have 
 Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related technical field.
 Experience in fintech or another regulated industry.
 Early-stage startup background.
 Hands-on LLM orchestration or prompt engineering.
 Background in software engineering, QA or product analytics.
Why Join Vivid?
 We have a hybrid model in our Limassol and Berlin offices, or fully remote outside office locations. 
 We support relocation to Cyprus (visa, package) when needed.
 AI-first culture – we use it every day, not just talk about it.
 Learning & development budget to support your professional growth. 
 Fully paid vacation and sick leave. 
 Sports compensation. 
 Real growth prospects, significant responsibility, and the ability to make an immediate impact from day one.
Compensation range
 Final compensation is determined individually, based on your experience, skills and the scope of the role, assessed against objective, gender-neutral criteria.
About Vivid
 At Vivid, we're on a mission to change how businesses and individuals manage their money across Europe. For businesses, we build tools that actually make a difference: multi-IBAN accounts, high-yield savings, business cashback, team cards, and accounting integrations that save real time — all in one place. And for individuals, we offer a simple way to manage and grow your wealth: access to global stocks, ETFs and 150+ cryptocurrencies, cashback, and personalised financial insights.
Our mission? Your success. Everyone deserves the chance to see their finances flourish, and we're dedicated to empowering our customers to make this a reality.
Founded in 2019 in Berlin by Alexander Emeshev and Artem Iamanov, Vivid has quickly grown into one of Germany's top financial platforms for SMEs and private accounts. Since then, we've expanded rapidly across Europe, earning the trust of over 500,000 customers — and with over €200 million raised and a valuation of €775 million, we're just getting started.
We're building Vivid as an AI-native organization — across every function, from product to compliance to operations. Automation handles a growing share of day-to-day execution. For us, this means our teams can focus on architecture, strategy, and high-impact decision-making. This changes how we work: less manual execution, more ownership in building systems that scale. We want to help define what AI-native looks like in a regulated financial environment — and we're looking for people who want to build that future with us.

* Experience coordinating several agile squads and managing technical and functional dependencies
* Strong stakeholder management skills and experience working with international Product, Engineering and Business teams

* Very good English skills
**Desirable qualifications**
Experience with digital consumer products, apps or platforms
Initial experience with make-or-buy or partner decisions
Experience working with Product and Development teams across different international markets
**What we offer**
**Innovative projects:** Become part of a team working on AI-based consumer products with a broad reach and high relevance.
**Flexible working models:** Benefit from flexible working hours and hybrid working models that support your work-life balance.
**Professional development:** Take advantage of extensive training programmes, continuous learning opportunities and clear career paths.
**Modern working environment:** Work with the latest technologies in an innovative, agile and dynamic environment.

title: Product Manager UX/UI & AI (m/w/d)
description:
FunnelCockpit ist eine All-in-one-Plattform, mit der Unternehmen ihre Online-Marketing- und Vertriebsprozesse aufbauen und automatisieren. Wir entwickeln unser Produkt kontinuierlich weiter und setzen dabei stark auf moderne AI-Technologien.
Dafür suchen wir eine:n Product Manager:in mit starkem Fokus auf UX/UI und Design: Du verstehst unsere Nutzer, machst aus ihren Problemen klare, einfache Lösungen und sorgst dafür, dass FunnelCockpit nicht nur viel kann, sondern sich auch gut anfühlt. * Du entwickelst AI-gestützte Workflows, mit denen wir schneller von der Idee zum fertigen Feature kommen.
**Qualifikation**

* Erfahrung als Product Manager, Product Owner, Product Designer oder UX/UI Designer, idealerweise bei einem SaaS-Produkt oder einer Webanwendung.
* Ein sehr gutes Gespür für UX, verständliche Nutzerführung und gutes visuelles Design.
* Umfangreiche praktische Erfahrung mit AI-Tools wie Claude, Codex oder Cursor.
* Erfahrung mit Vibe Coding: Du hast schon selbst Prototypen, Tools oder kleine Apps mit AI gebaut.
* Gutes technisches Grundverständnis für Webanwendungen, damit du mit Entwicklern auf Augenhöhe sprechen kannst. Klassische Programmiererfahrung ist kein Muss.
* Du arbeitest strukturiert, eigenverantwortlich und triffst pragmatische Entscheidungen.
* Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und gute Englischkenntnisse.
Besonders interessant ist dein Profil, wenn du schon mit Marketing-Tools, Landingpage- oder Funnel-Buildern gearbeitet hast und uns Beispiele für Designs oder Projekte zeigen kannst, die du selbst mit AI gebaut hast.
**Benefits**
------------
* Großer Einfluss auf Produkt und Design von Anfang an.
* Kurze Entscheidungswege und die Möglichkeit, Ideen schnell umzusetzen.
* Viel Eigenverantwortung statt starrer Prozesse.
* 100% Remote mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten.
* Eine moderne, AI-gestützte Arbeitsweise.
* Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsführung.
Bitte schick uns mit deiner Bewerbung Links oder Beispiele zu deinen Designs und deinen mit AI gebauten Projekten. Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen.

Join us at Lovehoney, where pleasure combines with creativity, data, and innovation!

title: Senior Product Manager (all genders)
description:
About GeneralMind 
 GeneralMind builds AI Systems of Action for complex enterprise workflows. We deploy AI employees that automate messy operational handovers across supply chains - processing orders, validating invoices, coordinating suppliers, and handling exceptions directly on top of enterprise systems like SAP, Oracle, JDE, and Dynamics.
 Our platform combines AI agents, operational context graphs, and real transaction data to achieve Autopilot-grade automation in real operational environments.
 We work closely with leading global companies across manufacturing, retail, and logistics to deploy AI into mission-critical workflows.
 About the role 
 We are looking for a Senior Product Manager who can operate at the intersection of enterprise operations, AI systems, and platform product strategy.
 You will work closely with customers, founders, and engineering teams to understand how large enterprises actually operate: ERP systems, supply chain workflows, approvals, exceptions, emails, spreadsheets, and fragmented operational processes.
 This is not a traditional roadmap-management role. A core part of the job is identifying the reusable platform hidden underneath customer-specific operational problems. You will help determine what becomes a platform capability and what stays customer-specific, where configuration ends and engineering begins, where AI can reliably automate workflows, and where humans should remain in the loop.
 What you will do 
 Work directly with enterprise customers to deeply understand operational workflows and pain points.
 Translate customer realities into scalable product and platform decisions.
 Define roadmap priorities across platform, workflow, and AI capabilities.
 Collaborate closely with engineering teams on architecture and product tradeoffs.
 Drive product thinking around AI agents, workflow orchestration, and enterprise operations.
 Identify recurring patterns across customers and turn them into reusable product abstractions.
 Help define the long-term platform strategy of the company.
 Improve how we capture, operationalise, and learn from customer feedback.
 What we are looking for 
 Strong product thinking and systems intuition.
 Deep understanding of enterprise operations, supply chain workflows, or ERP systems.
 Ability to operate effectively in highly technical environments.
 Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills.
 Ability to balance customer needs with long-term platform strategy.
 A strong ownership mentality and execution focus.
 Comfort operating in ambiguous, fast-moving startup environments.
 Fluency in English.
 Excitement about AI-native products and autonomous systems.

title: Senior Product Manager - Ad Traffic Quality (all genders)
description:
JustPlay is searching for an experienced Senior Product Manager - Ad Traffic Quality to join our team to take ownership of safeguarding our players and protecting our platform’s integrity by designing, implementing, and optimizing innovative systems to detect and prevent fraud across our loyalty gaming ecosystem.
You’ll combine strategic product ownership with a hands-on, data-driven approach to solve emerging issues while building systems and tools that improve detection precision.
 Job Responsibilities
 Define and own ad traffic quality and fraud prevention strategies, identifying risks across ad impressions, onboarding, engagement, and monetisation flows. 
 Develop and deploy real-time detection mechanisms, anomaly analytics, and proactive interventions to mitigate malicious behavior and abuse. 
 Collaborate with data, engineering, and product teams to build robust detection pipelines, alert systems, and responsive workflows. 
 Prioritize fraud-related KPIs such as false positives, chargeback rates, fraud velocity, and user friction metrics, driving continuous optimization. 
 Integrate A/B testing and iterative validation to refine detection models and user intervention flows. 
 Influence product design to incorporate fraud-resilient ad experiences and sustainable monetisation practices, while minimizing friction for legitimate players. 
 Stay informed on global fraud trends in mobile gaming and ad revenue-based platforms to keep our defenses innovative and effective. 
 Job Requirements
 4+ years of product management experience, ideally in digital products with complex user behavior and ad-driven monetisation models. 
 Strong experience in AdTech or ad monetisation, such as attribution, measurement platforms, or ad networks. 
 Strong analytical and data-driven mindset, with experience using behavioral data, patterns, and signals to improve product decisions. 
 Proficient in designing and measuring the impact of A/B tests in risk and fraud scenarios. 
 Skilled at cross-functional collaboration with engineers, analysts, and operations to drive implementation of scalable fraud solutions. 
 Excellent problem-solving mindset, analytical orientation, and strong communication skills. 
 Nice to have: Experience with behavioral fraud, KYC/identity verification, Trust & Safety, risk management, or fraud prevention. 
 Job Benefits
 Work-Life Balance and Flexibility: Flexible working hours and options for digital nomads, occasional office visitors, or regular office-goers
 Mental Health Support: Free personal coaching through our partner OpenUp to support our team members to live fulfilled lives at home and at work
 Training & Development: A competitive personal development budget of up to 2000€/year for training, conferences, workshops, etc. and free language tutoring in German and English with Preply
 Germany-Based Benefits: 25 vacation days, free Wellhub gold subscription, free monthly Deutschland-Ticket, and a monthly €50 tax-free internet contribution
 State-of-the-Art Equipment: Doesn’t matter if you are a MacBook or Windows user; we will provide you with the technical gear you need to succeed
 A Relocation Package: Includes visa support for those who need it
 Berlin Office Perks: Ergonomic setup, free daily lunch, and a dog-friendly environment. 
 Engaging and Diverse Work Environment: Join a diverse team, with over 30 nationalities working from over 25 different locations
 Benefits may vary depending on location and contract type. Do not hesitate to ask us about more details on our benefits offer.
 About Us
 Come join the team building the engine behind rewarded mobile gaming – making playtime truly rewarding. At JustPlay, we’re on a mission to power a fairer, more sustainable rewarded gaming ecosystem where users earn real value for their time through a self-sustaining model.
Since launching in 2020, we’ve grown into one of the world’s leading rewarded gaming platforms, with 25M+ downloads and 500K+ daily active users. Headquartered in Berlin and backed by NCSoft, one of the world’s leading gaming companies, we continue to operate fully independently – combining the speed, ownership, and ambition of a startup with the long-term backing of a global gaming powerhouse.
With a team across 20+ countries, we’re shaping a major shift in mobile gaming – and it’s still early enough for you to make your mark. At JustPlay, you’ll build end-to-end, move fast, and ship work that reaches millions – in a company that’s profitable, built to last, and focused on outcomes over hype.
 Everyone's welcome here
 At JustPlay, we believe different perspectives help us build better products. With team members from 30+ nationalities, different experiences and backgrounds are an important part of how we work and grow.
 We hire based on skills, potential, and how you work. Your age, gender, ethnicity, religion, disability, sexual orientation, or background don't come into it. If you don't meet every requirement in this ad, apply anyway. We know great candidates don’t always tick every box and some of our best hires didn't either. We are looking forward to your application!

title: (Senior) Product Manager (w/m/d) Public Cloud
description:
At IONOS, the leading European provider of cloud sovereign infrastructure, cloud services and hosting services, you will work together with a wide range of teams. We are characterized by open structures, a friendly working culture and flat hierarchies with a strong team spirit. We firmly believe that work and fun are compatible, and offer you the right environment for this. Our constant growth means that we are always looking for new colleagues. Become part of IONOS and grow with us.
 Tasks 
 Define and drive the long-term vision, strategy, and holistic roadmap for our Public Cloud service portfolio, aligning engineering capabilities with market demand and business growth.
 Evaluate emerging technologies - such as specialized GPU infrastructure and accelerated computing - to identify strategic entry points for our cloud platform (AI infrastructure knowledge is a strong plus).
 Design, implement, and optimize sophisticated monetization strategies, specifically focusing on consumption-based (Pay-as-you-Go), tiered, and subscription pricing models tailored for enterprise clients.
 Develop robust business cases, monitor unit economics, and manage financial success metrics (revenue, margin, CLV, churn) to ensure profitable growth of the cloud portfolio.
 Conduct continuous market, competitor, and analyst (e.g., Gartner, IDC) assessments. Act as the "voice of the enterprise customer" to identify unaddressed needs and high-value business opportunities.
 Drive relationships, technology alignment, and commercial agreements with global hardware/software suppliers and technology partners. Own the orchestration of Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), lead complex price and contract negotiations, and align partner roadmaps to optimize our cloud platform's cost structure, margins, and strategic positioning.
 Lead cross-functional alignment across Engineering, Operations, Sales, and Marketing to launch new capabilities and maximize market adoption.
 Evaluate and nurture strategic partnerships with global technology vendors, open-source communities, and integrators to expand the platform’s value proposition.
 Qualification 
 University degree (Master’s or Bachelor’s) in Business Administration, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related hybrid field.
 Minimum 5+ years (8+ for Senior) of proven experience in Strategic Product Management within a Public Cloud Provider (IaaS/PaaS), Managed Service Provider (MSP), or large-scale B2B Enterprise IT Infrastructure environment.
 Deep understanding of cloud economics, financial modeling, and the mechanics of consumption-based/metered billing models. Proven track record of owning or heavily influencing product P&L.
 Demonstrated ability and proven experience defining product strategies and navigating complex market dynamics.
 Strong foundational understanding of cloud architecture, infrastructure services, or advanced cloud-native business solutions, enabling you to sit at the table with principal engineers and architects.
 Exceptional communication skills in English; ability to influence executive stakeholders and articulate complex technical value propositions into clear business outcomes. German language skills are a valuable asset but not mandatory.
 Benefits 
 Hybrid working model.
 Flexible working hours through trust-based working hours.
 At some locations a subsidized canteen and various free drinks.
 Modern office space with very good transport connections.
 Various employee discounts for activities and products.
 Employee events such as summer and winter parties, as well as workshops.
 Numerous training and development opportunities.
 Various health offers, such as sports and health courses

Other responsibilities include:
 Support the COO in shaping and prioritising the revenue roadmap
 Drive cross-functional projects across Sales, Go-to-Market, Customer Success, Operations and Automations
 Help design, improve and scale sales processes and internal operating structures
 Run customer calls and support stakeholder management across key accounts and partners
 Identify and implement automation opportunities across the revenue organisation
 Manage revenue KPIs, reporting and operational follow-through
 Build prototypes, test workflows and support new product or commercial experiments
 Contribute to international expansion and market development initiatives

 Unterstützung bei der technischen Angebotserstellung.
 Du beantwortest Ausschreibungen und unterstützt bei der Geschäftsentwicklung für Kunden aus dem Bereich Trassierung und Leitungsplanung.
 Du hast einen engen Kundenkontakt und führst eine kontinuierliche Kundenkommunikation rund um Arbeitsergebnisse gegenüber unseren Kunden in Wort und Schrift.
 Über dich
 Bei Ramboll unterstützen wir dich von Anfang an bei deiner persönlichen und beruflichen Weiterentwicklung. Um bei uns durchzustarten, solltest du folgende Voraussetzungen mitbringen:
 Du hast ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium im Vermessungswesen, in der Geographie bzw. Geoinformatik oder Geophysik, im Bau­ingenieur­wesen oder in einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung.
 Du hast mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Bereich der Planung von Trassierungsprojekten (vorzugsweise Freileitungen 110 kV, 220 kV und 380 kV).
 Technische Kenntnisse im Freileitungsbau und der einschlägigen Vorschriften, Gesetze und technischen Normen in Bezug auf Trassierung,
 Gute allgemeine EDV-Kenntnisse und Erfahrungen mit FM-Profil, SEIL++ oder FIMS3, MicroStation, AutoCAD, QGIS.
 Ein lösungsorientierter und souveräner Umgang mit unseren Kunden und Partnern ist dir wichtig.
 Du bist teamfähig, flexibel und ein Organisationstalent.
 Deine Aufgaben erledigst du selbstständig und verfügst dabei über eine strukturierte Arbeitsweise
 Du hast eine Leidenschaft für Nachhaltigkeit und ein hohes Interesse an erneuerbaren Energien und ihrer großen Vielfalt an Technologien.
 Du hast fließende Deutschkenntnisse und kommunizierst auch ausgezeichnet auf Englisch.
 Bist du bereit dabei zu sein?
 Bitte reiche deine Bewerbung mit einem aktuellen Lebenslauf online ein.
 Bitte lade alle verfügbaren Arbeitszeugnisse (oder, wenn du außerhalb Deutschlands gearbeitet hast und keine Arbeitszeugnisse hast, die Kontaktdaten von Referenzen) aus deinen früheren Arbeitsverhältnissen und das Zeugnis deines höchsten Abschlusses hoch. Dies wird dazu beitragen, einen reibungslosen und schnellen Prozess zu ermöglichen, falls dir die Position angeboten wird. Wenn diese Dokumente nicht hochgeladen werden, könnte dies den Prozess verzögern.
 Wir freuen uns über jede Form der Vielfalt und ermutigen Bewerber:innen mit diversem Erfahrungshintergrund, sich zu bewerben.
Wir wissen, dass sich manche Bewerber:innen nur dann bewerben, wenn sie sämtliche Anforderungen erfüllen. Dabei sind Leidenschaft, Lernbereitschaft und Potenzial oft wichtiger als ein lückenloser Lebenslauf. Unsere unterstützende Lernkultur bei Ramboll bietet dir den Raum, dich fachlich und persönlich weiterzuentwickeln. Wenn dich diese Rolle anspricht, solltest du dich bewerben. Vielleicht bist du genau die passende Verstärkung für diese oder eine andere Position in unserem Team.
 Willkommen in unserem Geschäftsbereich Energie
 Ramboll erarbeitet für den Energiesektor Konzepte und Lösungen entlang der gesamten Wertschöpfungskette: von der Energiegewinnung und -erzeugung über die Übertragung bis hin zur Verteilung. Mit unserer internationalen und interdisziplinären Fachkompetenz decken wir als Planer und Berater die volle Bandbreite für On- und Offshore-Windenergieprojekte ab. Unsere Experten für Energiesysteme entwickeln neue Wärmesysteme und optimieren bestehende Anlagen. Und im Bereich Photovoltaik begleiten wir unsere Kunden von Machbarkeitsstudien und Ausschreibungen bis hin zur Inbetriebnahme.
 Arbeit im Zentrum des nachhaltigen Wandels bei Ramboll in Deutschland
 Ramboll ist ein international tätiges Architektur-, Ingenieur- und Beratungsunternehmen. Als stiftungseigenes Unternehmen mit Wurzeln in Dänemark verfolgen wir das Ziel, nachhaltigen Wandel zu gestalten – für eine lebenswerte Zukunft von Mensch und Natur. Dieser Anspruch prägt sowohl unser Handeln als auch unsere Arbeitsweise. Unsere Geschichte gründet auf einer klaren Vorstellung davon, wie ein verantwortungsbewusstes Unternehmen handeln sollte. Offenheit und Neugier bilden dabei das Fundament unserer Kultur. In Deutschland arbeiten über 1.300 Mitarbeitende an 15 Standorten an innovativen, multidisziplinären Lösungen – unter anderem in den Bereichen Gebäude, Transport und Energie. Durch die Verbindung lokaler Expertise mit globalem Wissen tragen wir dazu bei, die Gesellschaften von morgen zu gestalten.
